body: Cards with no counter definitions now show a direct, right-aligned Add counter button in the same 44px action row. Existing and archived-only counters retain the menu; draft/write guards and section dividers remain. The full gate passes 255 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests. Release counters/card-layout suites pass in Chromium and WebKit; 36 layout cases cover phones, tablets, desktops and short landscape. The rebuilt/restarted manual app preserves all 44 prior source versions, two pins, preferences and certificate; trusted HTTPS verifies all 33 build files. Physical-device and full release acceptance remain open. See progress/2026-09-30-empty-counter-action.md.

metadata.summary: Show a direct Add counter action on empty cards
